title: Interleave Playlist Tracks
description: An audio streaming application needs to reorganize a user's playlist. Given a singly linked list representing the tracks in the order L0 -> L1 -> ... -> Ln-1 -> Ln, reorder the playlist to follow this pattern: L0 -> Ln -> L1 -> Ln-1 -> L2 -> Ln-2 -> ... You may not modify the values in the list's nodes, only the links themselves must be altered.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 5 * 10^4].
input_format: The head of a singly linked list representing the playlist.
output_format: The head of the reordered singly linked list.

examples.explanation: Tracks are interleaved from the outer edges inward.
Middle track remains properly positioned after outer elements.
A single track playlist remains unchanged.
